text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was getting ready for the training camp,
Haiseiko called out to me—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
<nickname> is really shining bright right now, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is pounding!
I just want to connect with you even more,
<nickname>-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Her own dreams, the fans' feelings, their expectations...
I'm sure she's shouldering so much.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Turn everything into a springboard to become stronger!
If it's you, <nickname>-chan,
I know you can do it—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Let me help you sparkle even brighter♪
Please, leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Haiseiko...
<chrname> gained wonderful insight!
